_fields.maxEnchantBonus: stat block from the site's gear list (/db/gear/en.json 'st'). Verified on all 152 detailed items: it equals the bonus at the highest enchant level (detail.enchants[-1]), NOT base stats. Base stats = detail.mainStats (only for detailed items)
_fields.detail: present only for Heroic/Mythic weapons+armor+accessories and Unique (41) daggers/bows, one id per name+slot (other ids with the same name have no detail); fetched from /db/item/en/{id}.json

_scope: All dagger + bow weapons, all armor (7 slots; the site has no armor-class restriction) and accessories (earring/ring/necklace/bracelet/amulet/belt/rune). Excluded: other weapons, wings, titles, arcana, pantheon decor.
